title: The sandbox image carries pi, not only omp and claude
description:
FOUND 2026-09-22 when the operator asked 'assume it's with pi and not omp?' The answer today is NO.

The sandbox image carries two harnesses and pi is not one of them:
  image/common.sh:64    harness="${TICKS_HARNESS:-omp}"
  image/common.sh:145   'unknown harness kind … — this image carries omp and claude'
omp is oh-my-pi (github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi), a Bun-runtime fork of pi, installed in the ticks image's Dockerfile from a pinned release with a checksum.

So every per-tick sandbox xte builds would run omp. xte's definition of done says pi on GLM 5.3, and njj pairs 'runner pi, executor cloudflare-sandbox' - a pairing the image cannot currently execute. This GATES xte's done, which is why it is absorbed here rather than filed to the backlog (the gvc criterion).

THE REPO BOUNDARY: image/ in this repository is VENDORED byte-for-byte from the ticks repository's cloud/sandbox/, and ticfac does not edit it. The change is made in ticks (cloud/sandbox/Dockerfile to install pi at a pinned version with a checksum, exactly as omp is; common.sh and worker.sh to accept a 'pi' harness kind with its own launch and provider-config cases) and then re-vendored here.

qu3 IS THE SAME FACT SEEN FROM THE OTHER SIDE. workers-ai/… is omp's model spelling and cloudflare-workers-ai/… is pi's. The two spellings are two harnesses, not a typo. Settle qu3 together with this tick: once the sandbox runs pi, pi's own spelling is the one the boot must accept.

pi's non-interactive shape is already verified in this repo (internal/runconfig/kinds.go, tick gjk): pi -p --model <provider/model> '<prompt>', with --approve for an untrusted path.
